name: markora-extension-components
description: Typed, host-rendered custom components in Markora Markdown documents.

scripts.build: node ./scripts/cleanDist.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node ./scripts/copyStyles.mjs && node ../../scripts/fix-node-esm-specifiers.mjs dist
scripts.prepack: pnpm run build && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run smoke:node-esm
scripts.smoke:node-esm: node --input-type=module -e "const mod = await import('./dist/index.js'); for (const name of ['defineComponent', 'createComponentRegistry', 'createComponentsExtension']) if (typeof mod[name] !== 'function') throw new Error(name);"
